sense: a time when someone is taught

pins.definition: A period of time when students are taught by a teacher.
The time when students are taught by a teacher, or the activity of teaching a subject.
A period of instruction in a school or university, or with a teacher.

situation: A teacher stands in front of a classroom pointing to a large chalk diagram on a blackboard.
subject: a period of instruction
brief: A woman teacher stands before a green chalkboard covered in handwritten diagrams and equations, holding a wooden pointer against a drawn timeline. In the sunlit rows before her, several young students look up attentively with notebooks open on their wooden desks.
